quarterly_data.quarter: Rolls-Royce press release: Rolls-Royce strengthens freighter market position by (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The Airbus A350F completed its first test flight with Trent XWB-97 engines. Rolls-Royce says trust in the Trent XWB-97 has helped secure over 100 A350F orders, and that it has captured almost 90% of all A330ceo freighter conversions over the life of the programme (Trent 700). The Trent XWB-97 has more than 4.5 million engine flying hours over eight years; it has received the first two of three durability enhancement packages, and the third, entering service in 2028, doubles time on wing in challenging environments and gives a 50% improvement in benign conditions. The release cites an expected demand for 1600 widebody freighter aircraft over the next 20 years.
quarterly_data.figure: over 100 A350F orders; almost 90% of A330ceo conversions
